u03-rem-close.resolution: Checked each flag against the Greek; none is a meaning error. Psalm 71 [72] is right (LXX 71 = English 72); the next fragment heading '72 arg.' is the edition's apparatus. 'as long as the sun endures' renders ἐφ' ὅσον ὁ ἥλιος (the verb is understood). 'they mock … the one' and 'they speak evil of the one who chooses righteousness' turn the passive genitive participles (χλευαζομένου, κακῶς ἀκούοντος ἐπὶ τῷ δικαιοσύνην αἱρεῖσθαι = 'being ill spoken of for choosing righteousness') into active clauses with the same referent and sense. The bracketed '[will be blessed]' and '[perhaps: hardships]' are marked conjectures at lacunae the edition prints with dots. Jeremiah 15:19 identifies the quoted Ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψῃς, καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω σε. The rest are particle, participle and aspect style.
